title: Lesson Calendar – Monthly Grid – Student with Archived Lesson Allocation – Not Shown as Lesson Attendee
description: AC-5 - Decision Table: a student whose Lesson Allocation has been archived is excluded from the attendee list of lessons shown on the Lesson Calendar grid, since LessonCalendarHandler's Student_Sessions__r subquery filters Is_Archived__c = FALSE.
preconditions:
- Lesson L1 is scheduled on 2026-05-18 at Location Tokyo HQ, with Student A and Student B both assigned via Student Sessions.
- Student A's Lesson Allocation has since been archived (Archived_At__c is populated, session Is_Archived__c = TRUE).
- Student B's Lesson Allocation remains active (Archived_At__c is blank, session Is_Archived__c = FALSE).
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Lesson Calendar and navigates to 2026-05-18 at Location Tokyo HQ"
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens Lesson L1's card/detail from the calendar"
steps_result:
1. "Lesson L1 is shown on the calendar grid"
2. "The attendee list shows Student B only"
steps_data:
1. "calendar_date = 2026-05-18"
2. "Student A Is_Archived__c = TRUE -> excluded; Student B Is_Archived__c = FALSE -> included"

title: Lesson Calendar – Lesson Detail Drawer – Attendance Status Badge – Archived Student Excluded from Count
description: AC-5 - Boundary / Decision Table: the attendance-status badges (absent/trial/reallocated counts) shown on a Calendar lesson card exclude a student whose Lesson Allocation is archived, since LessonHandler.getLessonAttendeeStatuses filters Is_Archived__c = FALSE.
preconditions: - Lesson L2 is scheduled on 2026-05-19 at Location Tokyo HQ with 3 Student Sessions: Student A (active, marked Absent), Student B (active, Trial), Student C (Lesson Allocation archived, Archived_At__c populated).
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Lesson Calendar for 2026-05-19 at Location Tokyo HQ"
2. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the Absent/Trial count badges on Lesson L2's card"
steps_result:
1. "Lesson L2 is shown with attendance badges"
2. "Absent count = 1 (Student A), Trial count = 1 (Student B); Student C is not counted in any badge"
steps_data:
1. "calendar_date = 2026-05-19"
2. "Student C Is_Archived__c = TRUE -> excluded from getLessonAttendeeStatuses"

title: Available Teacher Calendar – Month Overlay – Student with Archived Lesson Allocation – Lesson Not Shown
description: AC-5 - Decision Table: a student's lesson is excluded from the Available-Teacher Calendar's student-month overlay when the student's Lesson Allocation is archived, since AvailableTeacherHandler.getStudentLessonsForMonth filters Is_Archived__c = FALSE.
preconditions:
- Student A has Lesson L3 on 2026-05-20 at Location Tokyo HQ, assigned via a Student Session whose Lesson Allocation has since been archived (Archived_At__c populated).
- Student A has a second Lesson L4 on 2026-05-21 with an active Lesson Allocation (Archived_At__c blank).
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Available Teacher Calendar, selects Student A, and views May 2026"
2. "HQ or CM Staff inspects 2026-05-20 on the overlay"
steps_result:
1. "The month overlay shows Lesson L4 only on 2026-05-21"
2. "No lesson is shown for Student A on this date"
steps_data:
1. "month = 2026-05"
2. "Student A's L3 session Is_Archived__c = TRUE -> excluded"

title: Lesson Calendar – Unarchive Round Trip – Same Lesson Allocation Restored – Student Reappears Without Duplicate Session
description: AC-3 / AC-5 - State Transition: after a student's archived Lesson Allocation is restored (same Id, Archived_At__c cleared), the student reappears as an attendee on the Lesson Calendar using the original Student Session, with no duplicate session created.
preconditions: Lesson L5 is scheduled on 2026-05-22 at Location Tokyo HQ. Student A's Lesson Allocation LA-1 was archived on 2026-05-10 (Archived_At__c = 2026-05-10), hiding Student A's existing Student Session SS-1 from the calendar.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Lesson Calendar for 2026-05-22 at Location Tokyo HQ"
2. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's course group, triggering the sync to rebuild and unarchive LA-1 (same Id)"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Lesson Calendar for 2026-05-22 at Location Tokyo HQ"
steps_result:
1. "Lesson L5's attendee list does not include Student A"
2. "LA-1's Archived_At__c is cleared"
3. "Lesson L5's attendee list now includes Student A again, using the original Student Session SS-1"
steps_data:
1. "LA-1 Archived_At__c = 2026-05-10"
2. "LA-1 Id unchanged; Archived_At__c = null"
3. "SS-1 Id unchanged, Is_Archived__c = FALSE; no duplicate session created"
